guide.title: Korean BBQ in the South Bay: El Camino Real, Kiely Boulevard, Stevens Creek and Fremont
guide.intro: Tabletop Korean BBQ in the South Bay runs mainly along one road. El Camino Real carries three rooms in Santa Clara, between 3060 and 3561, and a fourth at 595 East El Camino Real in Sunnyvale. Two more stand away from that corridor: one on Kiely Boulevard, in a strip mall behind a 7-Eleven, and one inside Westfield Valley Fair on Stevens Creek Boulevard. Two are over the Alameda County line in Fremont, on Albrae Street and Boscell Road. What the eight share is a grill in the table. Some burn gas, one burns charcoal as well, and at several the staff take the tongs and cook for you. Three serve unlimited rounds: two hours on Boscell Road, ninety minutes on Albrae Street, and Beque Korean Grill's own FAQ names all-you-can-eat service without publishing a limit; 10 Butchers prices every cut a la carte.

sections.heading: El Camino Real: Santa Clara and Sunnyvale
sections.body:
Four of the eight sit on El Camino Real, three of them inside a mile of Santa Clara road and the fourth over the Sunnyvale line. Street numbers run down from 3561 to 3060 on the Santa Clara side, and the Sunnyvale room is at 595 East El Camino Real.

Jang Su Jang is at 3561 El Camino Real, Suite 10. Barbecue is grilled at the table, and Eater placed the restaurant second in a 2016 Bay Area list limited to restaurants offering tabletop barbecue, setting its galbi against Han Il Kwan's. It carries a Michelin Guide recommendation, and the operator's site fronts two rooms, this one and a second in Milpitas. No source states its opening hours, so none are given here.

Chungdam Korean BBQ is at 3180 El Camino Real. Its own About page names grill-it-yourself meat and vegetables alongside hot pots and stews, and the staff will work the table grill for you. The San Francisco Chronicle names the barbecue as the draw and describes pork belly cut with heavy fat caps and beef short ribs carved into long bands, with steamed egg to eat while the grilling is done. It opens seven days: Monday to Thursday 11:30am to 2:30pm, with last call at 2:15pm, and 5pm to 9pm; Friday and Saturday 11:30am to 2:30pm and 5pm to 10pm; Sunday 11:30am to 2:30pm and 5pm to 9pm.

Beque Korean Grill is at 3060 East El Camino Real. The operator calls it a casual Korean BBQ restaurant with grill-it-yourself tables, so the meat is cooked at the table, and it names dine-in all-you-can-eat service at this room and at its San Francisco one on Post Street. An OpenStreetMap record at 3060 El Camino Real carries the tags cuisine=grill and korean. No source states its opening hours, so none are given here.

10 Butchers Korean BBQ is at 595 East El Camino Real in Sunnyvale. Its own site describes ten types of wagyu beef served at a BBQ table, and the staff work the grill at the table, turning the meat and cutting it into even pieces with scissors. Every cut is priced a la carte rather than by unlimited rounds. It opens Monday to Thursday 11:30am to 2:30pm and 5pm to 9pm, Friday 11:30am to 2:30pm and 5pm to 10pm, Saturday 11:30am to 10pm, and Sunday 11:30am to 9pm.

sections.heading: Kiely Boulevard and Stevens Creek Boulevard
sections.body:
Two Santa Clara rooms sit away from the El Camino Real run: one in a strip mall on Kiely Boulevard, one on the mall floor at Westfield Valley Fair.

Korean Spring BBQ is at 1062 Kiely Boulevard, in a strip mall behind a 7-Eleven. Diners choose between old-school charcoal and gas grills at the table, which is a choice a kitchen does not offer. The San Francisco Chronicle names prime ribeye, spicy marinated pork and thinly sliced beef tongue among the cuts, places the restaurant in Santa Clara's Koreatown and records more than a decade on that block. No source states its opening hours, so none are given here.

Baekjeong KBBQ is at 2855 Stevens Creek Boulevard, Suite 1808, inside Westfield Valley Fair on the Santa Clara side of the mall. Servers cook the food on built-in table grills, and fans overhead draw the smoke off. The Infatuation reviewed the room in January 2026. No source states its opening hours, so none are given here.

sections.heading: Fremont: Albrae Street and Boscell Road
sections.body:
Fremont is in Alameda County rather than Santa Clara County, and its two rooms stand about three miles apart in the industrial blocks either side of Interstate 880. Both serve unlimited rounds against a clock.

Hungry Cow K BBQ is at 40470 Albrae Street, in the Albrae Street business park. Grill plates are changed at the table between rounds, and a mist runs from the dividers between the booths. The San Francisco Chronicle describes robots carrying marinated galbi, bowls of sliced garlic and fried chicken through the corridors between booths, and sets the all-you-can-eat time limit at 90 minutes. It opens Monday to Friday 11:30am to 11pm and Saturday and Sunday 11am to 11pm.

Gen Korean BBQ House is at 43476 Boscell Road. The chain's own site has guests grilling their selections on built-in tabletop grills, with unlimited rounds inside a two-hour limit, and it lists the Fremont room with the telephone number (510) 573-0447. An OpenStreetMap record on the same block carries the tags korean and barbecue. The company also runs a room on Reseda Boulevard in Northridge, Los Angeles, and one at Westfield Southcenter in Tukwila, Washington. No source states its opening hours, so none are given here.

faq.question: What is tabletop Korean BBQ, and what counts as it?
faq.answer: Tabletop Korean BBQ means the grill is part of the dining table: a gas or charcoal grill set into or dropped onto the table, with the meat cooked in front of the diners rather than in a kitchen. Who holds the tongs does not change it. At Gen Korean BBQ House on Boscell Road the guests grill their own selections; at Baekjeong KBBQ the servers cook the food on built-in table grills; at Chungdam Korean BBQ and 10 Butchers the staff will do the grilling if you let them. A Korean restaurant whose meat arrives already grilled from the kitchen is a different thing, however good the meat.

faq.question: Which of these restaurants publish opening hours?
faq.answer: Three do. 10 Butchers Korean BBQ opens Monday to Thursday 11:30am to 2:30pm and 5pm to 9pm, Friday 11:30am to 2:30pm and 5pm to 10pm, Saturday 11:30am to 10pm and Sunday 11:30am to 9pm. Chungdam Korean BBQ opens seven days, 11:30am to 2:30pm with last call at 2:15pm, then 5pm to 9pm Sunday to Thursday and 5pm to 10pm Friday and Saturday. Hungry Cow K BBQ opens 11:30am to 11pm Monday to Friday and 11am to 11pm at weekends. No source states hours for the other five, so none are given here.

faq.question: Where do I find charcoal rather than gas?
faq.answer: One room. Korean Spring BBQ, at 1062 Kiely Boulevard in Santa Clara, offers old-school charcoal alongside gas grills at the table, and the San Francisco Chronicle attributes the extra smoke on its prime ribeye, spicy marinated pork and thinly sliced beef tongue to that choice. The other seven are described by their sources as gas or built-in tabletop grills without naming a fuel.

faq.question: Which are all-you-can-eat, and are there time limits?
faq.answer: Three run unlimited rounds. Gen Korean BBQ House, 43476 Boscell Road in Fremont, sets a two-hour limit. Hungry Cow K BBQ, 40470 Albrae Street in Fremont, sets 90 minutes. Beque Korean Grill, 3060 East El Camino Real in Santa Clara, names all-you-can-eat dine-in service without publishing a limit. 10 Butchers Korean BBQ prices every cut a la carte.

faq.question: How far apart are the eight, and are they all in Santa Clara County?
faq.answer: Five are in Santa Clara, one in Sunnyvale and two in Fremont. The Santa Clara and Sunnyvale six are in Santa Clara County; Fremont is in Alameda County, which is why Hungry Cow K BBQ on Albrae Street and Gen Korean BBQ House on Boscell Road carry a different county on their records. The four El Camino Real addresses run from 3060 to 3561 in Santa Clara and then 595 East El Camino Real in Sunnyvale, so three of them are within about a mile of each other. Kiely Boulevard and Stevens Creek Boulevard are separate drives, and Fremont is a further drive north east.
